confusions: The reeve asks you to promise to seal the barrow, but both the verses and crown paths automatically leave it open. There's no way to actually seal it - the seal/open choice mentioned at the start doesn't seem to exist.
Score differential between paths (90 vs 65) is unexplained - both are wins, but crown path scores significantly lower despite achieving the same core goal.
suggestions: If seal-the-barrow is cut content, remove the reeve's sealing request and the gray priest's opening preference to avoid confusion about player agency.
If seal-the-barrow should be an option: add a third ending state where the player can actually choose to seal after using verses/crown, not just leave it open.
Clarify why crown path (65pts) scores so much lower than verse path (90pts) - whether it's intentional design or if crown path is missing bonus objectives.
Consider adding a combat difficulty indicator or alternative for non-combat classes (Envoy struggled with barrow-wight, taking 7 turns to defeat a 3-HP enemy).
